tfc_real_world.advancements.world.globe_: Travel to positive %s and -%s z, the two poles nearest to spawn
Map profile used for world generation.
tfc_real_world.create_world.spawn_mode.t:
Determines how the spawn location is calculated.
Geographic - uses real-world longitude and latitude.
Random - generates randomly from world seed.
Classic - uses standard coordinates.
tfc_real_world.create_world.spawn_center: Geographic longitude for spawn location (used in Geographic mode).
Geographic latitude for spawn location (used in Geographic mode).
